finding: Across six paired comparisons, digest reuse took 103.08 s less total caller time, with 86.1% fewer canonical checks in the observed counter windows. All twenty goals in the final-stage follow-up verified, including six final-stage interrupted and resumed tasks. An earlier-stage restart was correctly refused after its next source state changed; that remains an unresolved recovery limit.
